name: HAWK CHUA
author: plieuwski
description: Noise and modelling synth: each voice a live Chua circuit or noise program, through low pass gates into resonators and waveguides (piano, drums, voice, flute, brass, bowed, reed, birds), with temple, cathedral and mosque reverbs; 512 GM-style presets, ARP, SEQ, FREE EG and a 4-track tape. The FM-1 firmware, its own screen on the VIBE.
